test_results.summary: Fix round 1. PlatformTests 439 of 439 passed under the stack lock; all nine scripts/*.test.sh passed with yq 4.54.1 on PATH, and regression-paths.test.sh also passed on Linux in mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/sdk:10.0; scripts/check-infra-paths.sh exit 0; shellcheck, actionlint 1.7.12, floor-guard and the secret scan passed; all 12 breaks failed as expected through scripts/run-breaks.sh. Not re-run this round: the forbidden-terms search and check-infra-paths.test.sh on Linux.

assumptions: scripts/ci-gates.test.sh changed although the spec's Touches omits it: it pins ci-passed's needs and the jobs using install-compose, so the new job fails it otherwise. The change adds e2e-regression; no case was removed.

The script adds -z to the spec's git diff, because git quotes unusual names in plain --name-only output and a quoted name would match nothing and skip the suite. It also rejects an empty SHA, which git would otherwise read as HEAD.

yq is not installed here. yq 4.54.1 was downloaded from its GitHub release, checked against the release's SHA-256, and kept in /tmp/dd-ci-e2e-yq/bin. The script breaks' test_method puts that directory on PATH; on another machine, install yq v4 and change the prefix. CI's runner has its own yq, whose version was not checked.
actionlint ran from the local rhysd/actionlint:1.7.12 image, CI's version, over ci.yml, security.yml and deploy.yml.
scripts/security-local.sh was not run: no Terraform, Dockerfile or Compose file changed.

Diagnostics limit: run-regression.sh removes each group's stack and Playwright clears test-results on each run, so on an early group's failure the diagnostics step shows only the last group's logs and error-context files. The failing test's own output stays in the step log. Fixing it needs an e2e/ change, outside this role's paths.

Spec conflict resolved: the supervisor reworded the near-miss example path in docs/backlog/story-ci-e2e-regression.md line 92, and scripts/check-infra-paths.sh no longer reads a JSON escape as part of a path.

Not built, by the supervisor's decision: --wait-timeout 600 on e2e/run-regression.sh (e2e/ is outside backend-builder's paths). The supervisor files it as a low; until then a stuck start runs to the job's 60-minute timeout.

scripts/check-infra-paths.sh had no harness, and ShellHarnessTests forbids a shell harness under infra/, so scripts/check-infra-paths.test.sh is new. It needs one new floor-guard step in ci.yml to run in CI, which is beyond the spec's Touches and is not the wall-time edit the supervisor ruled out.

Fix round 1: scripts/test-lock.sh was added to the list beyond the brief. Without it the check as specified fails, because e2e/playwright.config.ts:3 and e2e/run-regression.sh:3 name it in comments. See conflicts.

The yq in /tmp/dd-ci-e2e-yq/bin matches the v4.54.1 yq_darwin_arm64 checksum. The Linux binary at /tmp/dd-ci-e2e-yq/linux/yq, left from the first build, matches no entry of the v4.54.1 checksum file, so it was not run; the first build's Linux runs may have used it. This round's Linux run used a fresh yq_linux_arm64 download matching its release checksum (189088da0c64...).
The check finds only paths written out as scripts/<name>.sh. A path assembled at run time, for example path.join('scripts', name), would not be seen; no such path exists under e2e/ today.
conflicts: Step 2 NOT DONE: the guard denied backend-builder's write to docs/backlog/story-ci-e2e-regression.md although the brief allowed it, and it was not worked around. The supervisor needs to add two rows after the scripts/regression-paths.list row of the trigger table: scripts/operations-token.sh (the job's own files: the regression project runs it for an operations token) and scripts/test-lock.sh (named in e2e/ comments only; listed so the every-script check holds). The spec is in the diff hash, so this edit moves the hash off 9af9dbd135e4 with no change to code or tests.

scripts/test-lock.sh in the list goes past D1 (every stack input plus the job's own files): the job never runs it, so a change to it alone starts the suite for nothing. It was kept so the check stays 'named anywhere' as the fix list says. The alternative is to reword the two e2e/ comments, or have the check skip comments, and drop the line; that is a decision for the supervisor.
